params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { columns: [{ key, label, type?, align?, sortable?, hidePhone?, shed?, title? }], filters?: [{ key, type, label, options? }], actions?: [{ label, href?, variant? }], empty?: { heading?, description? }, pageSize?, selectable?, rowKey?, bulkActions?: [{ id, label, variant? }] }. A column key names a property of TItem in camel case (orderNo for OrderNo).

params.name: Load
params.doc: Loads one page for the request's page, sort, search and filters and returns its items and the total of the whole (searched) list. Throwing shows the element's error state with Retry; zero items show the empty state.

params.name: Cells
params.doc: Cell templates by column key (the config column key, camel case): each fills the cell of that column in every loaded row, with the item. A column without one shows its value. Needs IdOf.

params.name: Columns
params.doc: Typed columns (the PkDataTable column type): replaces the columns of Config. A column with a Cell template fills that cell of every loaded row with the item (needs IdOf). A column with Text shows that text under its Key, and a Key with neither names a property of TItem in any casing, as on PkDataTable. Title and HidePhone shape the phone cards.

params.name: IdOf
params.doc: The row key of an item (the config rowKey property, default id): names the cell slots of the loaded rows. Ids must not contain a double quote.

params.name: RowHrefTemplate
params.note: Row links: an address like /orders/{id} (or #/orders/{id}); {id} is the row key and any {field} a camel-case row property, URL-encoded. The first cell of each row becomes a real link (new tab, middle click, copy address) and a plain click navigates through the app router without a reload. Use it for a routed list-to-record pair; OnRowClick stays for an imperative handler.

params.name: Navigate
params.note: Who follows a RowHrefTemplate link on a plain click: "router" (default), "host" (a notification, nothing navigates) or "none" (the browser follows the address).

params.name: ActionsContent
params.doc: Content in the title bar, beside the title (as PkPageHeader ActionsContent): a callback button, or a PkMenu of several actions. The title bar stays shown when Config sets no heading or breadcrumb.

params.name: ToolbarContent
params.doc: Content at the end of the list toolbar, beside the search box and after the Config actions (as PkDataTable ToolbarContent).

params.name: OnRowClick
params.note: A row was clicked (or Enter or Space on the focused row): Id is the row key (config.rowKey, default id), Row the row as JsonElement. The usual handler navigates to the record page. Setting it makes the rows clickable.

notes: PkListPage<TItem>: load(query) is a callback property, set from script, so the generated component hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot) that calls the Load parameter with the page, sort, search and filters; a Load that throws rejects the JavaScript promise, which the element shows as its own error state with Retry. rowHref is synchronous in the element and cannot cross the interop boundary; use RowHrefTemplate (real row links to a route, a typed RowHref(TItem) is not generated: the generator has no function-to-template step) or OnRowClick (an imperative row click handler) or Config actions. Cells (column key to a RenderFragment<TItem>) with IdOf fill the cell-<id>-<key> slots of each loaded row (issue 1000); the page forwards them to its table. Columns (PkTableColumn<TItem>) replaces config.columns and its Cell templates fill the cell slots like Cells (issue 1000). Selection (issue 873): Config selectable/rowKey/bulkActions switch it on; OnSelect (pk-select) and OnBulk (pk-bulk, a bulkActions button) are EventCallbacks. For Selected, SelectedChanged, a BulkContent slot and the compacted large selection use PkDataTable.
